sections.title: Current services and authorisation
paragraphs: The nominated credit licensee for the proposed arrangement is Finsure Finance and Insurance Pty Ltd, ABN 72 068 153 926, Australian Credit Licence 384704. Unified Loans’ current corporate credit representative number, the scope and commencement of its appointment, and approval for use of the Lumio brand must be confirmed against the appointment records before credit assistance is provided. This document does not assert that Lumio has a separate licence or that a particular individual representative number is the company’s number.

This website currently provides product information, rule based calculators and consumer or commercial enquiry forms. The member dashboard and customer login are offline and under development. An enquiry is saved for analyst follow up. It is not a lender application, a credit check, a recommendation to enter a particular contract or an approval. A website confirmation is not confirmation that email or SMS has been delivered.

sections.title: Credit assistance and separate documents
paragraphs: If your enquiry progresses, the analyst will identify the responsible representative and licensee and provide the applicable final Credit Guide, collection notices, required consents, any credit quote and proposal disclosure before the relevant service. The website terms are not a loan contract or a substitute for those documents. A lender’s agreement governs any loan it makes.

sections.title: Eligibility and accurate information
paragraphs: You must be at least 18 and able to enter the relevant arrangement. Availability depends on lender policy, location, loan purpose and your circumstances. Provide accurate, current information and tell the analyst if it changes. Do not impersonate another person or provide information without authority. Initial identity and business registration entries are not verification.

sections.title: Consumer, business, joint and trust enquiries
paragraphs: Choose the purpose that reflects the actual use of funds. A business purpose declaration must be truthful and must not be used to avoid consumer protections. Consumer credit legislation applies according to the facts and law, not just the label selected. For a business or trust, identify the legal applicant, structure, trustee and relevant owners or directors accurately. An authorised contact cannot give every consent on behalf of another director, joint applicant or guarantor; separate authority and consent may be required.

sections.title: Anika and lender comparisons
paragraphs: Anika’s current calculator explanations follow calculation rules. Live lender policy matching, credit scoring and personalised AI assessment are not connected to this website. Planned recommendations are intended to explain participating lender policy fit and costs, but are not the lender’s credit decision. An illustrative probability or policy score is not a verified chance of approval.

Any future comparison is limited to the products, lenders and current information actually considered. We do not claim to compare the entire market or guarantee the cheapest rate. The analyst should explain material limitations, missing evidence, uncertainty and reasons for any proposed lender change. Your informed choice and any submission consent remain separate.

sections.title: Rates, fees and remuneration
paragraphs: Actual rates, comparison rates, repayments, fees, charges, conditions and any security depend on the lender, product and individual assessment. Review the written quote and loan contract, including upfront and ongoing fees, any balloon or residual, early repayment charges and total cost. A smaller repayment may reflect a longer term or a final amount owing.

Any fee payable to Unified Loans or the Lumio service must be disclosed and agreed through the required documents before it is charged. Lenders may pay upfront or ongoing commissions; licensee, aggregator and referral arrangements can involve sharing remuneration. Material remuneration, referral benefits and conflicts will be disclosed as required. These terms do not create a customer obligation to repay commission clawback or impose an undisclosed cancellation fee.

sections.title: Calculators and general information
paragraphs: Calculator rates and fees are assumptions, not advertised or personalised lender offers. Results depend on inputs, fixed rate and timing assumptions, rounding and included fees. They do not assess your full position or guarantee affordability, tax savings, approval, a property value or an insurance benefit. Information is general and does not constitute legal, tax or financial product advice. Seek advice suited to your circumstances before committing.

sections.title: Privacy and communications
paragraphs: Our Privacy Policy and Enquiry Privacy Agreement explain collection, sharing, access, correction and complaints. Sending an enquiry authorises the limited handling described in that notice and contact about the enquiry; it does not authorise a credit check, open banking connection, identity check or unrestricted AI training. Optional marketing and analytics choices are separate. Use a contact method suitable for your circumstances and tell us if you need accessible communication.

sections.title: Vehicles, leasing and insurance
paragraphs: Vehicle inventory, dealer messaging, trade in bids, reservations, history and market comparisons are planned services, not live purchase or settlement commitments. Dealer and data provider terms must be reviewed if those services are connected. A novated lease requires employer and provider agreement and review of costs, residual and job change risks. A credit authorisation does not itself authorise insurance or other financial product advice or dealing; any such service requires separately identified authorisation and product disclosures.

sections.title: Safe and lawful use
paragraphs: Do not upload passwords, full bank account details, tax file numbers or identity documents through an enquiry form. Do not interfere with security, submit malicious content, use automated abuse or infringe others’ rights. We may restrict access where reasonably necessary for security, law or misuse, while preserving applicable rights and complaint access.

sections.title: Availability, intellectual property and third parties
paragraphs: Services can be changed or interrupted for maintenance, development, security or legal reasons. Do not rely on the site for urgent payment instructions or hardship notices to a lender. Lumio, Unified Loans and technology owners retain their respective rights; lender logos remain their owners’ marks. A logo is not an endorsement, approval or promise of an available product. Third party contracts and notices apply to their services.

sections.title: Your rights and responsibility
paragraphs: Nothing in these terms excludes a consumer guarantee, privacy right, statutory obligation, remedy or liability that cannot lawfully be excluded. We do not exclude responsibility merely because software or a contractor was involved. We are not liable to the extent loss is caused by inaccurate information you knowingly provide or your unlawful misuse, subject to applicable law and our own contribution. These terms do not impose a blanket indemnity or waive AFCA, regulator or court rights.

sections.title: Complaints, changes and law
paragraphs: General enquiries: contact@lumiofinance.com.au. Complaints, compliance and privacy: compliance@lumiofinance.com.au. Telephone: 07 3523 6347. Correspondence: Unified Loans Pty Ltd, Lumio Finance enquiries, 34 Freedom Drive, Kallangur QLD 4503, Australia.

Our Complaints Policy explains internal review and escalation. Material changes to these terms will be published with an updated date; a website update does not retrospectively change an agreed fee or separate loan contract. Queensland law and applicable Commonwealth law apply, without restricting rights in another competent court or tribunal.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: How information is handled for Lumio enquiries and credit assistance delivered through Unified Loans.

paragraphs: Unified Loans Pty Ltd, ABN 77 655 584 606, ACN 655 584 606.

The description of this service arrangement does not itself establish a legal partnership, joint venture or a separate credit licence for Lumio.

General enquiries: contact@lumiofinance.com.au. Complaints, compliance and privacy: compliance@lumiofinance.com.au. Telephone: 07 3523 6347. Correspondence: Unified Loans Pty Ltd, Lumio Finance enquiries, 34 Freedom Drive, Kallangur QLD 4503, Australia.

This policy distinguishes the enquiry website available now from credit services that may follow. Applicable obligations include the Privacy Act 1988 and Australian Privacy Principles, and credit reporting rules where the entity and activity are covered. Finsure, lenders and independent providers also have their own responsibilities and notices.

sections.title: Information collected now
paragraphs: Consumer enquiries can include name, phone, email, loan product and purpose, requested amount and term, relationship and enquiry type, employment, gross income sources and frequency, living arrangement, citizenship or residency, living expenses, assets and liabilities. Car enquiries can include vehicle condition, seller type, deposit, trade in registration, state and estimated value. The optional live financial snapshot uses tax residency and income tax treatment selections, housing contributions and itemised liability figures. It calculates in the browser; the entered enquiry fields are stored if you choose to submit, while the editable sidebar example rate is not part of the enquiry record.

Commercial enquiries can include business name and website, structure, ABN, ACN, trust and trustee details, directors’ or authorised contacts’ names and roles, turnover, expenses, assets, liabilities and contact details. We also hold consent confirmations and the enquiry reference. General, professional partner and community forms collect their labelled contact, organisation and proposal information. Do not include children’s personal information in community proposals.

Technical infrastructure processes requests, browser and network information needed to deliver and protect the service. If optional analytics are enabled, the site records only approved page paths and action labels; form answers, names, contact details and loan amounts are excluded from those analytics events.

sections.title: How information is collected
paragraphs: We collect information you enter and submit, communications with our team and necessary technical information from your use of the site. Where you provide another person’s information, have authority and tell them about this policy. We may need to collect directly from them before providing services. Calculators process scenario inputs in the browser; entering the same figures in an enquiry sends them to us.

sections.title: Purpose and consequences of not providing information
paragraphs: We use enquiry information to understand your request, arrange analyst contact, identify what additional information is needed, maintain enquiry records, address complaints and protect the service. Required fields are needed to process this form; if you prefer not to provide them online, contact us to discuss an alternative. Optional information can be omitted. Enquiry details are stored in the site database after successful submission.

sections.title: Information and permissions for later credit services
paragraphs: If you proceed, Unified Loans and the relevant representative may need further information about identity, finances, business affairs, credit history, guarantees and supporting evidence. We will explain the purpose, recipients, relevant legal requirements and consequences at that time. Credit reports, identity verification, open banking, lender submission and electronic signatures require the appropriate notice, authority or consent; an enquiry checkbox is not blanket approval. Do not send government identifiers or financial documents through the present form.

sections.title: Sharing between Lumio, Unified Loans and Finsure
paragraphs: Information is made available to authorised personnel dealing with your Lumio enquiry through Unified Loans. Where relevant and lawful, information may be provided to Finsure for authorised credit assistance, compliance oversight, complaints, recordkeeping and licensee obligations. We should explain when an enquiry is progressing to such handling and provide applicable notices.

Finsure Finance and Insurance Pty Ltd identifies its own information handling in its privacy policy at www.finsure.com.au/privacy-policy/. The fact that entities work together does not authorise unrelated marketing or unlimited reuse.

sections.title: Other recipients and technology providers
paragraphs: Where necessary and lawfully authorised, recipients may include a selected lender, professional adviser you appoint, approved referral partner, verification provider, contractor, insurer or service provider, and regulators, courts or dispute resolution bodies. Current infrastructure includes Cloudflare hosting and database services, the ChatGPT Sites access layer and Google Fonts. Stoik Technology provides or develops the AION, Anika and related technology described on the site. Access must be limited to the actual service and authorised purpose; not all planned integrations are connected.

sections.title: Anika AI, improvement and model training
paragraphs: The current forms do not run a live lender matching or generative AI assessment. Anika’s receipt message is a scripted confirmation after storage, and calculator explanations use rules. We do not treat your enquiry consent as permission to train a general purpose AI model on identifiable personal, credit or sensitive information.

Any proposed use or disclosure to Stoik for identifiable model training or a materially different secondary purpose requires a separately assessed lawful basis, clear notice and consent where required. Necessary service processing is distinct from optional training. Deidentified data may only be used for improvement after assessing reidentification risk and safeguards; removing a name alone is not sufficient. Do not assume a related company or a “business improvement” purpose removes privacy obligations.

sections.title: Sensitive information, credit information and identifiers
paragraphs: We do not request health diagnoses, biometric templates, racial or ethnic background, government identity numbers or credit reports in these enquiry forms. A medical loan purpose or a pension category can reveal more than you intend, so avoid unnecessary detail. Sensitive information may only be collected and handled on an applicable lawful basis, including consent where required. Later credit information handling must be explained in the relevant credit reporting notice; this policy does not authorise a credit check.

sections.title: Overseas processing and storage
paragraphs: Hosting, access infrastructure, support and their subprocessors may involve Australian or overseas processing. A complete current list of processing countries and service provider arrangements has not yet been confirmed for the planned full platform; we do not promise that all information stays in Australia. Contact the privacy officer before submitting if you need country or provider details. Before adding a new overseas disclosure we must identify the relevant recipients and locations where practicable, assess applicable safeguards and update notices. This policy does not seek a waiver of Australian Privacy Principle 8 protections.

sections.title: Security and data incidents
paragraphs: We use hosting security features and application controls appropriate to the current service, including restricted server APIs, input validation, same origin checks, consent controls and separation of legacy user records. Access must be limited to people who need information for their role. No online system is risk free. Do not rely on statements about planned controls as certification of implemented security. Suspected incidents should be reported to compliance@lumiofinance.com.au. We assess and respond to incidents and make notifications when legally required.

sections.title: Retention and disposal
paragraphs: Enquiries and related communications are retained while reasonably needed for the enquiry, service, complaints, legal obligations or a lawful recordkeeping requirement. Credit assistance records may have specific retention requirements; a blanket period does not apply to every website visitor or data category. The current enquiry service does not provide an automatic deletion schedule or self service dashboard deletion. Request review or deletion through the privacy contact. Information no longer needed must be securely destroyed or deidentified where required, subject to lawful retention and proportionate backup management.

sections.title: Access, correction and deletion requests
paragraphs: Contact compliance@lumiofinance.com.au or 07 3523 6347 to request access, correction, information about use or disclosure, or deletion where available. We may verify identity and authority without requesting excessive information. We respond within a reasonable period and explain any lawful refusal and available review options. We do not charge for making an access or correction request; any permitted access cost must be reasonable and explained in advance. A deletion request is not an automatic right to remove records we must lawfully retain.

sections.title: Marketing, cookies and choices
paragraphs: The service contact consent is separate from optional marketing. If we send permitted marketing, a simple opt out must be available. Optional website analytics are off unless you enable them and can be changed using Privacy choices. The site respects its implemented Do Not Track preference. See the Cookie and Analytics Notice for the present implementation. You do not have to accept optional analytics to make an enquiry.

sections.title: Privacy complaints and updates
paragraphs: General enquiries: contact@lumiofinance.com.au. Complaints, compliance and privacy: compliance@lumiofinance.com.au. Telephone: 07 3523 6347. Correspondence: Unified Loans Pty Ltd, Lumio Finance enquiries, 34 Freedom Drive, Kallangur QLD 4503, Australia.

Tell us what happened and the outcome you seek. We will consider privacy complaints and give you a response within a reasonable period, generally within 30 days. If unresolved after we have had an opportunity to respond, you can complain to the Office of the Australian Information Commissioner at www.oaic.gov.au, telephone 1300 363 992, subject to its process. Financial service complaints may also be eligible for AFCA. See our Complaints Policy.

This policy will be reviewed as the service changes. The date above identifies this version. Further information about provider locations, retention schedules, licensee arrangements and new integrations must be confirmed before relying on the policy for a broader service.

sections.title: What the enquiry is for
paragraphs: We collect the contact, financial, business and other information labelled in the form to record your request, understand your circumstances, arrange analyst contact and determine the next steps. Required fields enable online processing; optional fields can be left blank. If you do not wish to provide the required information online, contact us to discuss your options.

sections.title: Who may handle the enquiry
paragraphs: Authorised Lumio and Unified Loans personnel and the providers necessary to host, secure and support the service may handle your information. Finsure may receive relevant information for credit service or compliance purposes when applicable and lawful. A later lender application or specialist integration will require its own notice, authority and any necessary consent. Providers may process data overseas; country details and the limits of current information are explained in the Privacy Policy. Ask our privacy officer if you need clarification before submitting.

sections.title: What your agreement means
paragraphs: By selecting the enquiry consent checkbox and submitting, you ask Unified Loans, through the Lumio service, to store and review the enquiry and contact you about your stated finance goals. You acknowledge the linked Privacy Policy and this notice. You confirm your information is accurate to the best of your knowledge and you have authority for any other person’s or business information you provide.

This is not permission for an automatic lender submission, credit report, identity check, open banking connection, marketing subscription or identifiable AI model training. A joint applicant, director, trustee or guarantor may need to give separate authority or consent. Do not provide another person’s sensitive information without an appropriate basis.

sections.title: Your choices and rights
paragraphs: Contact compliance@lumiofinance.com.au to request access, correction, withdrawal of consent for future optional handling or to raise a privacy concern. Withdrawal may affect our ability to continue a requested service but does not undo lawful past handling or compulsory retention. The Privacy Policy explains complaint escalation. No consent waives a non excludable legal right.

sections.title: What we do and what the lender does
paragraphs: Within the scope of its verified authorisation, Unified Loans may assist you to consider and apply for credit from participating lenders. Lumio is the customer experience, and Stoik and Anika supply technology functions; neither is identified here as your lender or an independent licensee. Lenders assess applications, set their terms and decide whether to lend. No AI score, enquiry reference or preliminary match is an offer, preapproval or guaranteed outcome.

sections.title: Our comparison and panel
paragraphs: We do not compare every loan in the market. Available products depend on current lender accreditations, authorisation, your profile and the service being provided. The final guide and proposal must identify material panel limitations and commercial relationships. A panel size or lender logo on a marketing page is not confirmation that every product is available to you or that all lenders have been compared.

sections.title: Fees you may pay
paragraphs: A lender or third party may charge application, establishment, account, valuation, settlement, discharge, early repayment or other disclosed costs. Security and guarantee costs can also arise. Review the actual contract and written quote; fees differ by lender and product.

A fee for our assistance, if proposed, must be explained in an appropriate written credit quote or other lawful agreement before the service or charge requiring it. Do not assume our service is free, that the fee is a fixed amount, or that any particular fee will apply until the actual arrangement is disclosed and agreed. The final approved guide must state the actual fee policy.

sections.title: Commissions, referral payments and conflicts
paragraphs: Lenders may pay upfront and ongoing commission. Finsure or other authorised participants may receive or retain a share under the applicable arrangements, and a disclosed referral partner may receive a referral benefit. The final guide and required proposal disclosure must explain relevant direct and indirect remuneration, including fees payable by you, amounts or reasonable estimates and other detail required by law. Ask the analyst to explain any conflict and why an option is proposed. A lower interest rate alone does not prove the lowest total cost. These documents do not impose a commission clawback reimbursement on you.

sections.title: Responsible lending and your assessment
paragraphs: Where consumer responsible lending obligations apply to our assistance, we must make reasonable inquiries about your requirements, objectives and financial situation, take reasonable steps to verify the relevant financial situation and assess whether the proposed credit is not unsuitable. We must not provide assistance prohibited by those obligations. Where mortgage broker best interests and conflict priority duties apply, those duties also apply; they are not displaced by technology or remuneration. Commercial credit may fall outside parts of the consumer credit regime, depending on the facts. Do not sign an inaccurate business purpose declaration.

sections.title: Requesting a written assessment
paragraphs: Where the law gives you a right to a copy of our preliminary written assessment, you may request it without charge, generally within seven years after the assistance. It must be provided within the applicable statutory timeframe; a request before entry into the contract may require provision before the contract, and later requests generally have seven or 21 business day timeframes depending on timing. Contact compliance@lumiofinance.com.au. A calculator result or enquiry summary is not that assessment.

sections.title: Complaints and escalation
paragraphs: General enquiries: contact@lumiofinance.com.au. Complaints, compliance and privacy: compliance@lumiofinance.com.au. Telephone: 07 3523 6347. Correspondence: Unified Loans Pty Ltd, Lumio Finance enquiries, 34 Freedom Drive, Kallangur QLD 4503, Australia.

Make a complaint free of charge, verbally or in writing. We aim to acknowledge it promptly, generally within one business day or as soon as practicable, and provide the required internal response. Standard complaints are generally subject to a 30 calendar day response deadline; different deadlines or exceptions can apply to particular complaints. We will explain any lawful delay and escalation rights. You do not have to complain in a particular format or accept a recommendation to keep complaint access.
For the nominated licensee’s complaint channel: complaints@finsure.com.au; 1300 346 787, option 3; Compliance, Finsure Finance and Insurance Pty Ltd, Level 27, 10 Carrington Street, Sydney NSW 2000.

If dissatisfied or the required time has passed, contact AFCA: 1800 931 678; info@afca.org.au; www.afca.org.au; GPO Box 3, Melbourne VIC 3001. AFCA is free for eligible complainants and applies its jurisdiction and rules. The final guide must identify the applicable member and confirmed membership details; we do not invent an AFCA membership number.

Separate notices and permissions are needed for later credit reports, identity checks, banking data and lender submissions where applicable. Enquiry consent does not authorise identifiable model training. You can request human assistance and challenge an automated explanation. The dashboard is currently offline; the enquiry form does not perform live AI matching.

sections.title: Scope of this guide
paragraphs: A final Credit Guide is a disclosure document, not a credit offer or a guarantee that assistance will be provided. This draft does not authorise insurance advice, financial product advice, tax advice or deposit taking. Ask for the relevant authorised provider and product documents for any separate service.

complaints.title: Complaints and compliance
complaints.intro: Tell us what went wrong. We will listen, explain the review process and tell you how to escalate.

paragraphs: Unified Loans Pty Ltd, ABN 77 655 584 606, ACN 655 584 606. Lumio service complaints are handled through Unified Loans under the service arrangement described in these documents.

General enquiries can be sent to contact@lumiofinance.com.au. Use the email or phone channel for a complaint rather than relying on a website notification that is not connected.

sections.title: How to complain
paragraphs: You can complain verbally or in writing, without charge. Explain what happened, any reference you have, the outcome you want and a safe way to contact you. You do not need to use the word “complaint” or complete a particular form. You may use an authorised representative. Tell us if you need language, accessibility or other assistance; we will discuss reasonable support.

sections.title: How we review your complaint
paragraphs: We aim to acknowledge a complaint promptly, generally within one business day or as soon as practicable. We assess the issue fairly, investigate relevant records and seek further information where needed. The final response should explain the outcome and reasons, any remedy, and your escalation rights. For standard financial service complaints the required response is generally within 30 calendar days. Different deadlines or limited exceptions may apply, including certain credit reporting and hardship matters; we will explain any applicable deadline and any lawful delay. An urgent hardship request for an existing loan should also be made directly to the lender.

sections.title: Licensee escalation
paragraphs: You may raise relevant issues directly with the nominated licensee, Finsure Finance and Insurance Pty Ltd: complaints@finsure.com.au; 1300 346 787, option 3; Compliance, Level 27, 10 Carrington Street, Sydney NSW 2000. The current Unified Loans authorisation and AFCA member details are being confirmed for the final Credit Guide. We will identify the responsible entity rather than treat Lumio, Unified Loans and Finsure as the same legal person.

sections.title: Independent financial complaint review
paragraphs: If you are dissatisfied or an applicable response deadline has passed, you may contact the Australian Financial Complaints Authority, subject to its rules and jurisdiction: 1800 931 678; info@afca.org.au; www.afca.org.au; GPO Box 3, Melbourne VIC 3001. AFCA provides free independent review of eligible complaints. You do not have to complete every internal step before contacting AFCA for information. Do not delay seeking help because a website or dashboard is unavailable.

sections.title: Privacy complaints
paragraphs: Contact compliance@lumiofinance.com.au. Allow us a reasonable opportunity to respond, generally 30 days. If unresolved, you may complain to the Office of the Australian Information Commissioner at www.oaic.gov.au or telephone 1300 363 992, subject to its process. Financial and privacy complaint rights can overlap. Nothing here prevents contacting a regulator, obtaining advice or using another lawful remedy.

sections.title: Optional analytics

Enquiry answers, names, contact details, financial figures and query strings are not sent as those analytics event fields. No third party advertising pixel is currently installed.

sections.title: Your controls

Changing the choice affects future optional events; it does not automatically erase a lawfully held enquiry or essential security records.
